tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot reports high-frequency sign oscillation and contains responses of both signs. The sigmoidal onset does not resolve that nonstationarity, so I abstain from forecasting at H = 1.1 without spending on another probe.

considered_alternatives.option: Weibull, Avrami, and Richards saturation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The inflection signature alone favors a saturation model, but these fixed-sign laws cannot match the positive and negative paid responses.
Finer sampling could characterize the oscillations, but the observed high-frequency sign-oscillation signature already triggers abstention.
This probe does not distinguish mechanisms relevant to the forecast.
